item.description: ☑️ Reminder: the call for Local Organisers of the next BraveTech EU DefTech Forges remains open! BraveTechEU brings together the European Defence Fund, EUDIS, the European Defence Agency and BRAVE1. From 9–16 November 2026, selected organisations will host five-day intensive test campaigns together with local end-users and the consortium, helping technologies mature where they matter most. BraveTechEU is looking for innovation hubs, accelerators, testing centres, tech parks, and ecosystem builders willing to become trusted local nodes within the EU–Ukraine defence innovation network. As a Local Organiser, you will co-deliver a proven high-impact programme with the Civitta · Starburst · Darkstar consortium to support technologies addressing real operational needs, work directly with startups, SMEs, military users, and defence stakeholders, and strengthen your local defence innovation ecosystem. 📅 Application deadline: 15 July 2026 🎥 Learn more about the DefTech Forges: https://lnkd.in/eWkMfrR5 👉 Apply to host a DefTech Forge: https://tally.so/r/MerQd0 Léo B. item.title: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Sys...
item.description: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Systems” From 29 September to 1 October 2026, the European Defence Agency will hold the Test and Evaluation Community Days in Kiel, Germany. This 5th edition will bring together key European stakeholders to examine how Test & Evaluation (T&E) can better support defence readiness and accelerate capability development. Discussions will address topics such as wartime experience, Test and Evaluation resources in Europe, challenges in testing autonomous system, the role of AI in T&E, the need to attract and train the next generation of T&E experts, and the contribution of T&E to certification and qualification processes, including initiatives such as the Joint Ammunition Qualification (JAQ). If you wish to present a contribution aligned with the above-mentioned topics of interest, please complete the submission form by 26 June 2026 and send it to the organizers. Submission forms and registrations here: https://lnkd.in/efDM7_gv Léo B. item.title: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium receiv...
item.description: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium received more than 200 proposals in their first FSTP sub-call from almost all Member States, including Ukraine, with over 70% of eligible applicants participating in an EU defence funding programme for the first time. ▶️ This resonates with one of our recent posts on the introduction of FSTP under EDF, through which the MAJoR project aims to select up to 60 innovators to contribute with their specialized technologies and expertise to the targeted innovation challenges within the project, without navigating the full EDF application process. Successful applicants will receive up to €60,000 in funding and participate in a 6-month business development support programme. A total of 3.6 million EUR is reserved for both sub-calls within MAJoR. 📍 Next steps Looking ahead, the second MAJoR sub-call and the first sub-call under the BATTLEVERSE project, will take place, offering further opportunities for innovative companies to participate in EDF-funded projects. 🚀More information on FSTP in EDF: https://lnkd.in/eisZFtrF Léo B. item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. item.title: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on ...
item.description: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on new Art. 136 of the Financial Regulation 2024/2509, leading to a more detailed and practice-oriented guidance, including: - Clarified ownership & control assessment criteria - Concrete examples, validity period, specific cases - Checks of intermediate ownership layers - New participants joining an action - Loss of eligibility scenarios - Expanded guidance on guarantees process - Clearer procedures for informing concerned entities 🔎 The new 2026 Ownership Control Declaration template must be used by the applicants and can be found under the Funding & Tenders Portal → EDF Reference Documents → Templates & Forms → Application Forms. The key difference compared to the old template is the difference between EU-controlled and non-EU controlled declarations (now more detailed, with non-EU countries identification, indication if those are eligible under specific calls). ▶️ Good to know: 📍 OCA validity period has been extended up to 36 months, 📍 OCA average process lasts 3 months, and work cannot begin before the entity (e.g. subcontractor, third party..) is validated (costs incurred not eligible for EU funding before) 📍 Ownership changes need to be notified immediately to DG DEFIS 👍 More information and tutorials available on the EDF official webpage: https://lnkd.in/ecnGG66U hashtag #EUDefenseIndustry Léo B. item.title: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All projec...
item.description: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly. To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices. ⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned ! 🎙️ Aleš Lipnik, Doit-R Solutions Aleksander majeric, TECES, Green Tech Cluster), coordinator of the INDY, Energy independent and efficient deployable military camps project (EDF 2021) and partner in NOMAD PROJECT EU(EDF 2021) and Sentinel Project (EDF 2024) Iztok Spacapan, Instrumentation Technologies and the ARCHYTAS (EDF) project (EDF 2023) Žiga Mlinarič, SkyLabs d.o.o. and the Staalion project (EDF 2023 SME development action project) Jan Knezevic, SSRD and the Small UAS project (EDF 2024) Ziga Brencic, Jozef Stefan Institute and the SQORPION project (EDF 2024) 🙋‍♂️ Léo B., Alain Dinis 💡 🌎, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Grubesic Bruno The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency.

item.title: 🚨 The FSTP option under EDF: background and update for 2026 🚨 ▶️ FSTP (Financial Support to Third Parties) also known as...
item.description: 🚨 The FSTP option under EDF: background and update for 2026 🚨 ▶️ FSTP (Financial Support to Third Parties) also known as “cascade funding” is a measure used throughout different EU programmes to redistribute EU funding, implemented and managed by selected consortia via sub-calls for proposals. 📍 Under the European Defence Fund, it allows smaller players, the “third parties”, to gain faster & lighter access to funding with reduced financial risk towards faster innovation cycles and a first entry to the defence ecosystem. On the other hand, EDF consortia benefit from accelerated technology scouting and access to niche innovation as well as risk distribution to reach TRL maturity. 👉 2 ongoing EDF projects (MaJoR – EDF Work Programme 2023 (https://lnkd.in/ekFAcGUn) and Battleverse Project – WP 2024) have been and will be launching 2 sub-calls distributing up to €60K grants per selected third party. Under EDF 2025 WP, 2 calls required cascade funding to be included in the selected actions. 📍 Under the EDF 2026 Work Programme, FSTP is optional for all EDF calls. This can be decided at the proposal level among partners, and will have to be implemented according to the following rules: - FSTP budget represents a maximum of 5% of the total EU requested contribution, and each third party can receive up to EUR 60K - FSTP is implemented via min. 2 sub-calls per project where a minimum of 3 recipients per sub-call are selected for funding and to integrate an acceleration programme with a duration of max. 6 months. 🔎 Guidelines for FSTP under EDF: https://lnkd.in/exFNzStF Léo B. item.description: ▶️ Save The Date! 📅 3-4 June 2026 ENDR Conference Gijón 2026 - “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry” In the framework of The European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Asturias Hub defensa ( ASTURIAS HUB DE DEFENSA) - Asturias Technology Business Association for the development of the Defence Industry - will host the European conference “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”. 🗺️ The event will take place Gijón, Asturias (Spain), on 3-4 June 2026, at the Laboral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial. 🔎 The conference will bring together key policymakers, industry leaders, SMEs, and stakeholders from the defence and dual-use entrepreneurial ecosystem, alongside civilian technology innovators, clusters, and defence business associations. It will also engage academia, research and technology organisations, higher education and VET providers, research funding bodies, specialised media, as well as EU, national, and regional authorities, and international organisations. Registration: https://lnkd.in/eT2Hjm8T Léo B.
